name: Infinite War Assembly
backstory: A protected commander keeps the production account open while two lighter combat machines earn arena revenue. The factory invests in income before premium equipment.
strategy_personality: A particularly convincing factory-and-economy stable. Select one faction before drafting the roster. It is a separate property from Total Annihilation despite their design lineage. [Publisher description](https://store.steampowered.com/app/9350/Supreme_Commander/).

robots.name: UEF Commander
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.


Subject: Authentic original Supreme Commander UEF Armored Command Unit, massive blocky broad-shouldered humanoid command mech, tiny central head, thick grey armour with blue team panels, stocky two legs and immense feet. Source right arm gun and left construction manipulator, recognizable original game ACU proportions. No shield effects, no human pilot or escort.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #122 slot 1 UEF Commander.
robots.refinement_note: Tycoon follows the supplied strategy rule: no weapon refinements. This is an explicit empty plan.
robots.equipment_interpretation: UEF Commander fills the protected tactical support role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Tactician tuning supports the mid equipment role; defensive stance and a 25% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Tycoon strategy tuning rules with the Tactician Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Supreme Commander  
**Strategy:** Tycoon · **Target roster:** 3 robots

**Catalogue key:** `infinite-war-assembly`

**Proposed robots:** UEF Commander; Mech Marine 02; Titan 03.

**Direction:** A particularly convincing factory-and-economy stable. Select one faction before drafting the roster. It is a separate property from Total Annihilation despite their design lineage. [Publisher description](https://store.steampowered.com/app/9350/Supreme_Commander/).

**Production edition:** Supreme Commander — 2007 base game; UEF faction; blue team colours. Custom arena names and equipment are adaptations; source machine identities remain as specified.
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–2; follow income-facility goals before recruiting slot 3 with a funded complete stage-0 loadout. Upgrade final equipment in slot order after the roster and income base are secure. No weapon refinement purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
